codeSnippets.description: Type-safe generic repository implementation with dynamic reflection-based column selection in GORM
Reusable AST clause expression builders for composable and parameterized queries

patterns.codeStructure: pkg/db/generic_repository.go defines GenericRepository[T schema.Tabler], AST expression helpers (Search, Equal, InArray, ExpressionDateRange), and reflection struct extractors.
considerations: Requires struct tags with gorm:"column:..." for dynamic column projections
All repository methods receive context.Context for cancellation and timeout propagation
Clause expressions use parameter binding to prevent SQL injection
keyImplementationPoints: Go generics constraint on schema.Tabler interface ensuring compile-time safety
Parameterized AST clause expressions to prevent SQL injection and enable composable queries
Dynamic reflection projection via extractSelection to fetch only requested columns
patterns.overview: Generic repository pattern for GORM leveraging Go 1.18+ type parameters to provide type-safe CRUD, dynamic expression building, and reflection-based selective field loading.
patterns.purpose: Provide a centralized, reusable, and type-safe data access layer that eliminates boilerplate CRUD while retaining fine-grained query control.
patterns.summary: Type-safe generic repository abstraction with dynamic GORM expression builders and reflection-driven column projections.
patterns.title: Go GORM Generic Repository & Dynamic Expression Builder Pattern

codeSnippets.description: Multi-repository unit-of-work transaction coordinator in Go GORM

patterns.codeStructure: pkg/db/dbTransaction.go provides DBTransaction struct and BaseRepository interface.
considerations: Repositories must implement BaseRepository.SetupConnection to swap the active GORM session instance
Always handle deferred rollback/commit with defer trx.End(err) to prevent hanging transactions
keyImplementationPoints: Decoupled transaction management from business usecase layer
Transparent DB session switching across multiple participating repositories
Atomic rollback or commit via unified End(err) method
patterns.overview: Declarative unit-of-work transaction manager that coordinates multiple repositories within an atomic GORM transaction.
patterns.purpose: Coordinate atomic operations spanning multiple separate repository instances without leaking transaction handle objects directly into business domain logic.
patterns.summary: Declarative Multi-Repository Unit-of-Work Transaction Coordinator managing GORM transactions across distinct repositories.
patterns.title: Declarative Multi-Repository Unit-of-Work Transaction Coordinator

codeSnippets.description: Domain error classification with typed errors and semantic predicate helpers
Standardized API envelope formatting for error and validation responses

patterns.codeStructure: pkg/localerror/util.go, pkg/middleware/custom-translation-validator.go, and shared/payload/response.go define error classification, validator translations, and HTTP response envelopes.
considerations: Use errors.As and errors.Is for safe error inspection across wrapped call stacks
Avoid leaking sensitive internal database errors in public JSON responses
keyImplementationPoints: Strongly-typed custom domain errors for data validation, access control, and internal faults
Translation override integration with go-playground/validator for localized field error messages
Consistent JSON response envelope containing meta, data, and granular field error arrays
patterns.overview: Hierarchical error handling and validation architecture combining custom domain error types, localized validator messages, and uniform JSON response envelopes.
patterns.purpose: Provide predictable, typed, and localized error responses across all API endpoints while shielding internal system details from clients.
patterns.summary: Domain error classification, custom validation translation, and standardized HTTP response envelopes in Go.
patterns.title: Structured Domain Error Hierarchy & Response Mapping Pattern

	Lang          string    `json:"lang"`
	Email         string    `json:"email"`

codeSnippets.description: Typed session context payload and context keys for request-scoped propagation

patterns.codeStructure: shared/api/api.go and shared/payload/user_context.go manage modular route registration and request-scoped session payloads.
considerations: Requires consistent registration of module routers during application bootstrap
Context keys should be typed to avoid key collisions across middlewares
keyImplementationPoints: Router interface allows modular feature packages to register route groups independently
Typed session data structure provides consistent user metadata across handlers and services
Context key encapsulation ensures safe retrieval from gin.Context / context.Context
patterns.overview: Modular HTTP routing and request-scoped user session propagation pattern for Gin web framework in Go.
patterns.purpose: Organize large API applications into pluggable module routers while standardizing session context injection.
patterns.summary: Modular router group registration pattern with typed user session context injection in Go Gin.
patterns.title: Modular Router Registration & Contextual Session Propagation
